verses.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.fr: Paul, apôtre de Jésus-Christ par la volonté de Dieu, aux saints qui sont à Ephèse et aux fidèles en Jésus-Christ:
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ፥ በኤፌሶን ላሉት ቅዱሳን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም ላሉት ምእመናን፤

verses.en: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: Que la grâce et la paix vous soient données de la part de Dieu notre Père et du Seigneur Jésus-Christ!
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
verses.fr: Béni soit Dieu, le Père de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ, qui nous a bénis de toutes sortes de bénédictions spirituelles dans les lieux célestes en Christ!
verses.am: በክርስቶስ በሰማያዊ ስፍራ በመንፈሳዊ በረከት ሁሉ የባረከን የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አምላክና አባት ይባረክ።

verses.en: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
verses.fr: En lui Dieu nous a élus avant la fondation du monde, pour que nous soyons saints et irrépréhensibles devant lui,
verses.am: ዓለም ሳይፈጠር፥ በፊቱ ቅዱሳንና ነውር የሌለን በፍቅር እንሆን ዘንድ በክርስቶስ መረጠን።

verses.en: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
verses.fr: nous ayant prédestinés dans son amour à être ses enfants d''adoption par Jésus-Christ, selon le bon plaisir de sa volonté,
verses.am: በበጎ ፈቃዱ እንደ ወደደ፥ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሥራ ለእርሱ ልጆች ልንሆን አስቀድሞ ወሰነን።

verses.en: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
verses.fr: la louange de la gloire de sa grâce qu''il nous a accordée en son bien-aimé.
verses.am: በውድ ልጁም እንዲያው የሰጠን የጸጋው ክብር ይመሰገን ዘንድ ይህን አደረገ።

verses.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
verses.fr: En lui nous avons la rédemption par son sang, la rémission des péchés, selon la richesse de sa grâce,
verses.am: በውድ ልጁም፥ እንደ ጸጋው ባለ ጠግነት መጠን፥ በደሙ የተደረገ ቤዛነታችንን አገኘን እርሱም የበደላችን ስርየት።

verses.en: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
verses.fr: que Dieu a répandue abondamment sur nous par toute espèce de sagesse et d''intelligence,
verses.am: ጸጋውንም በጥበብና በአእምሮ ሁሉ አበዛልን።

verses.en: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
verses.fr: nous faisant connaître le mystère de sa volonté, selon le bienveillant dessein qu''il avait formé en lui-même,
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ለማድረግ እንደ ወደደ እንደ አሳቡ፥ የፈቃዱን ምሥጢር አስታውቆናልና፤

verses.en: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
verses.fr: pour le mettre à exécution lorsque les temps seraient accomplis, de réunir toutes choses en Christ, celles qui sont dans les cieux et celles qui sont sur la terre.
verses.am: በዘመን ፍጻሜ ይደረግ ዘንድ ያለው አሳቡም በሰማይና በምድር ያለውን ሁሉ በክርስቶስ ለመጠቅለል ነው።

verses.en: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
verses.fr: En lui nous sommes aussi devenus héritiers, ayant été prédestinés suivant la résolution de celui qui opère toutes choses d''après le conseil de sa volonté,
verses.am: እንደ ፈቃዱ ምክር ሁሉን የሚሠራ እንደ እርሱ አሳብ፥ አስቀድመን የተወሰንን በክርስቶስ ደግሞ ርስትን ተቀበልን።

verses.en: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
verses.fr: afin que nous servions à la louange de sa gloire, nous qui d''avance avons espéré en Christ.
verses.am: ይኸውም፥ በክርስቶስ አስቀድመን ተስፋ ያደረግን እኛ ለክብሩ ምስጋና እንሆን ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
verses.fr: En lui vous aussi, après avoir entendu la parole de la vérité, l''Evangile de votre salut, en lui vous avez cru et vous avez été scellés du Saint-Esprit qui avait été promis,
verses.am: እናንተም ደግሞ የእውነትን ቃል፥ ይኸውም የመዳናችሁን ወንጌል፥ ሰምታችሁ ደግሞም በክርስቶስ አምናችሁ፥ በተስፋው መንፈስ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ታተማችሁ፤

verses.en: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
verses.fr: lequel est un gage de notre héritage, pour la rédemption de ceux que Dieu s''est acquis, à la louange de sa gloire.
verses.am: እርሱም የርስታችን መያዣ ነው፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ያለውን ሁሉ እስኪዋጅ ድረስ፥ ይህም ለክብሩ ምስጋና ይሆናል።

verses.en: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi moi aussi, ayant entendu parler de votre foi au Seigneur Jésus et de votre charité pour tous les saints,
verses.am: ስለዚህ እኔ ደግሞ በእናንተ ዘንድ ስለሚሆን በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስለ ማመንና ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ስለሚሆን መውደድ ሰምቼ፥

verses.en: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
verses.fr: je ne cesse de rendre grâces pour vous, faisant mention de vous dans mes prières,
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ እያመሰገንሁ ስጸልይ ስለ እናንተ ማሳሰብን አልተውም፤

verses.en: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
verses.fr: afin que le Dieu de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ, le Père de gloire, vous donne un esprit de sagesse et de révélation, dans sa connaissance,
verses.am: የክብር አባት የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አምላክ እርሱን በማወቅ የጥበብንና የመገለጥን መንፈስ እንዲሰጣችሁ እለምናለሁ።

verses.en: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
verses.fr: et qu''il illumine les yeux de votre coeur, pour que vous sachiez quelle est l''espérance qui s''attache à son appel, quelle est la richesse de la gloire de son héritage qu''il réserve aux saints,
verses.am: ሁሉንም ከእግሩ በታች አስገዛለት ከሁሉ በላይም ራስ እንዲሆን ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰጠው።

verses.en: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
verses.fr: et quelle est envers nous qui croyons l''infinie grandeur de sa puissance, se manifestant avec efficacité par la vertu de sa force.
verses.am: ሁሉንም ከእግሩ በታች አስገዛለት ከሁሉ በላይም ራስ እንዲሆን ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰጠው።

verses.en: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
verses.fr: Il l''a déployée en Christ, en le ressuscitant des morts, et en le faisant asseoir à sa droite dans les lieux célestes,
verses.am: ሁሉንም ከእግሩ በታች አስገዛለት ከሁሉ በላይም ራስ እንዲሆን ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰጠው።

verses.en: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
verses.fr: au-dessus de toute domination, de toute autorité, de toute puissance, de toute dignité, et de tout nom qui se peut nommer, non seulement dans le siècle présent, mais encore dans le siècle à venir.
verses.am: እርስዋም አካሉና ሁሉን በሁሉ የሚሞላ የእርሱ ሙላቱ ናት።

verses.en: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
verses.fr: Il a tout mis sous ses pieds, et il l''a donné pour chef suprême à l''Eglise,
verses.am: ሁሉንም ከእግሩ በታች አስገዛለት ከሁሉ በላይም ራስ እንዲሆን ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰጠው።

verses.en: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
verses.fr: qui est son corps, la plénitude de celui qui remplit tout en tous.
verses.am: እርስዋም አካሉና ሁሉን በሁሉ የሚሞላ የእርሱ ሙላቱ ናት።

verses.en: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
verses.fr: Vous étiez morts par vos offenses et par vos péchés,
verses.am: በበደላችሁና በኃጢአታችሁ ሙታን ነበራችሁ፤ በእነርሱም፥

verses.en: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
verses.fr: dans lesquels vous marchiez autrefois, selon le train de ce monde, selon le prince de la puissance de l''air, de l''esprit qui agit maintenant dans les fils de la rébellion.
verses.am: በዚህ ዓለም እንዳለው ኑሮ፥ በማይታዘዙትም ልጆች ላይ አሁን ለሚሠራው መንፈስ አለቃ እንደ ሆነው በአየር ላይ ሥልጣን እንዳለው አለቃ ፈቃድ፥ በፊት ተመላለሳችሁባቸው።

verses.en: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
verses.fr: Nous tous aussi, nous étions de leur nombre, et nous vivions autrefois selon les convoitises de notre chair, accomplissant les volontés de la chair et de nos pensées, et nous étions par nature des enfants de colère, comme les autres...
verses.am: በእነዚህም ልጆች መካከል እኛ ሁላችን ደግሞ፥ የሥጋችንንና የልቡናችንን ፈቃድ እያደረግን፥ በሥጋችን ምኞት በፊት እንኖር ነበርን እንደ ሌሎቹም ደግሞ ከፍጥረታችን የቁጣ ልጆች ነበርን።

verses.en: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
verses.fr: Mais Dieu, qui est riche en miséricorde, à cause du grand amour dont il nous a aimés,
verses.am: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር በምሕረቱ ባለ ጠጋ ስለ ሆነ፥

verses.en: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
verses.fr: nous qui étions morts par nos offenses, nous a rendus à la vie avec Christ c''est par grâce que vous êtes sauvés);
verses.am: ከወደደን ከትልቅ ፍቅሩ የተነሣ በበደላችን ሙታን እንኳ በሆንን ጊዜ ከክርስቶስ ጋር ሕይወት ሰጠን፥ በጸጋ ድናችኋልና፥

verses.en: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
verses.fr: il nous a ressuscités ensemble, et nous a fait asseoir ensemble dans les lieux célestes, en Jésus-Christ,

verses.en: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: afin de montrer dans les siècles à venir l''infinie richesse de sa grâce par sa bonté envers nous en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: በሚመጡ ዘመናትም በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ለእኛ ባለው ቸርነት ከሁሉ የሚበልጠውን የጸጋውን ባለ ጠግነት ያሳይ ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱ ጋር አስነሣን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም በሰማያዊ ስፍራ ከእርሱ ጋር አስቀመጠን።

verses.en: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
verses.fr: Car c''est par la grâce que vous êtes sauvés, par le moyen de la foi. Et cela ne vient pas de vous, c''est le don de Dieu.
verses.am: ጸጋው በእምነት አድኖአችኋልና፤ ይህም የእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ነው እንጂ ከእናንተ አይደለም፤

verses.en: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
verses.fr: Ce n''est point par les oeuvres, afin que personne ne se glorifie.
verses.am: ማንም እንዳይመካ ከሥራ አይደለም።

verses.en: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
verses.fr: Car nous sommes son ouvrage, ayant été créés en Jésus-Christ pour de bonnes oeuvres, que Dieu a préparées d''avance, afin que nous les pratiquions.
verses.am: እኛ ፍጥረቱ ነንና፤ እንመላለስበት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አስቀድሞ ያዘጋጀውን መልካሙን ሥራ ለማድረግ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ተፈጠርን።

verses.en: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, vous autrefois païens dans la chair, appelés incirconcis par ceux qu''on appelle circoncis et qui le sont en la chair par la main de l''homme, souvenez-vous
verses.am: ስለዚህ እናንተ አስቀድሞ በሥጋ አሕዛብ የነበራችሁ፥ በሥጋ በእጅ የተገረዙ በተባሉት ያልተገረዙ የተባላችሁ፥ ይህን አስቡ፤

verses.en: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
verses.fr: que vous étiez en ce temps-là sans Christ, privés du droit de cité en Israël, étrangers aux alliances de la promesse, sans espérance et sans Dieu dans le monde.
verses.am: በዚያ ዘመን ከእስራኤል መንግሥት ርቃችሁ ለተስፋውም ቃል ኪዳን እንግዶች ሆናችሁ በዚህም ዓለም ተስፋን አጥታችሁ ከእግዚአብሔርም ተለይታችሁ ያለ ክርስቶስ ነበራችሁ።

verses.en: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
verses.fr: Mais maintenant, en Jésus-Christ, vous qui étiez jadis éloignés, vous avez été rapprochés par le sang de Christ.
verses.am: አሁን ግን እናንተ በፊት ርቃችሁ የነበራችሁ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ሆናችሁ በክርስቶስ ደም ቀርባችኋል።

verses.en: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
verses.fr: Car il est notre paix, lui qui des deux n''en a fait qu''un, et qui a renversé le mur de séparation,
verses.am: ጥልንም በመስቀሉ ገድሎ በእርሱ ሁለታቸውን በአንድ አካል ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ያስታርቅ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
verses.fr: l''inimitié, ayant anéanti par sa chair la loi des ordonnances dans ses prescriptions, afin de créer en lui-même avec les deux un seul homme nouveau, en établissant la paix,
verses.am: ጥልንም በመስቀሉ ገድሎ በእርሱ ሁለታቸውን በአንድ አካል ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ያስታርቅ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
verses.fr: et de les réconcilier, l''un et l''autre en un seul corps, avec Dieu par la croix, en détruisant par elle l''inimitié.
verses.am: መጥቶም ርቃችሁ ለነበራችሁ ለእናንተ ሰላምን፥ ቀርበው ለነበሩትም ሰላምን የምስራች ብሎ ሰበከ፤

verses.en: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
verses.fr: Il est venu annoncer la paix à vous qui étiez loin, et la paix à ceux qui étaient près;
verses.am: በእርሱ ሥራ ሁላችን በአንድ መንፈስ ወደ አብ መግባት አለንና።

verses.en: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
verses.fr: car par lui nous avons les uns et les autres accès auprès du Père, dans un même Esprit.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከቅዱሳን ጋር ባላገሮችና የእግዚአብሔር ቤተ ሰዎች ናችሁ እንጂ እንግዶችና መጻተኞች አይደላችሁም።

verses.en: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, vous n''êtes plus des étrangers, ni des gens du dehors; mais vous êtes concitoyens des saints, gens de la maison de Dieu.
verses.am: በሐዋርያትና በነቢያት መሠረት ላይ ታንጻችኋል፥ የማዕዘኑም ራስ ድንጋይ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ነው፤

verses.en: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
verses.fr: Vous avez été édifiés sur le fondement des apôtres et des prophètes, Jésus-Christ lui-même étant la pierre angulaire.
verses.am: በእርሱም ሕንጻ ሁሉ እየተጋጠመ በጌታ ቅዱስ ቤተ መቅደስ እንዲሆን ያድጋል፤

verses.en: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
verses.fr: En lui tout l''édifice, bien coordonné, s''élève pour être un temple saint dans le Seigneur.
verses.am: በእርሱም እናንተ ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር መኖሪያ ለመሆን በመንፈስ አብራችሁ ትሠራላችሁ።

verses.en: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
verses.fr: En lui vous êtes aussi édifiés pour être une habitation de Dieu en Esprit.
verses.am: በእርሱም እናንተ ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር መኖሪያ ለመሆን በመንፈስ አብራችሁ ትሠራላችሁ።

verses.en: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
verses.fr: A cause de cela, moi Paul, le prisonnier de Christ pour vous païens...
verses.am: ስለዚህም አሕዛብ ስለ ሆናችሁ ስለ እናንተ የክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እስር የሆንሁ እኔ ጳውሎስ ለእግዚአብሔር እንበረከካለሁ።

verses.en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
verses.fr: si du moins vous avez appris quelle est la dispensation de la grâce de Dieu, qui m''a été donnée pour vous.
verses.am: ለእናንተ ስለ ተሰጠኝ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ጸጋ መጋቢነት በእርግጥ ሰምታችኋል፤

verses.en: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
verses.fr: C''est par révélation que j''ai eu connaissance du mystère sur lequel je viens d''écrire en peu de mots.
verses.am: አስቀድሜ በአጭሩ እንደ ጻፍሁ፥ ይህን ምሥጢር በመግለጥ አስታወቀኝ፤

verses.en: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
verses.fr: En les lisant, vous pouvez vous représenter l''intelligence que j''ai du mystère de Christ.
verses.am: ይህንም ስታነቡ የክርስቶስን ምሥጢር እንዴት እንደማስተውል ልትመለከቱ ትችላላችሁ፤

verses.en: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
verses.fr: Il n''a pas été manifesté aux fils des hommes dans les autres générations, comme il a été révélé maintenant par l''Esprit aux saints apôtres et prophètes de Christ.

verses.en: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
verses.fr: Ce mystère, c''est que les païens sont cohéritiers, forment un même corps, et participent à la même promesse en Jésus-Christ par l''Evangile,
verses.am: ይህም፥ አሕዛብ አብረው እንዲወርሱ፥ በአንድ አካልም አብረው እንዲሆኑ፥ በወንጌልም መስበክ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ በሆነ የተስፋ ቃል አብረው እንዲካፈሉ፥ ለቅዱሳን ሐዋርያትና ለነቢያት በመንፈስ አሁን እንደ ተገለጠ በሌሎቹ ትውልዶች ዘንድ ለሰው ልጆች አልታወቀም።

verses.en: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
verses.fr: dont j''ai été fait ministre selon le don de la grâce de Dieu, qui m''a été accordée par l''efficacité de sa puissance.
verses.am: እንደ ኃይሉ ሥራ እንደ ተሰጠኝም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ስጦታ መጠንየወንጌል አገልጋይ ሆንሁለት።

verses.en: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
verses.fr: A moi, qui suis le moindre de tous les saints, cette grâce a été accordée d''annoncer aux païens les richesses incompréhensibles de Christ,

verses.en: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
verses.fr: et de mettre en lumière quelle est la dispensation du mystère caché de tout temps en Dieu qui a créé toutes choses,
verses.am: ፍለጋ የሌለውን የክርስቶስን ባለ ጠግነት ለአሕዛብ እሰብክ ዘንድ፥ ሁሉንም በፈጠረው በእግዚአብሔር ከዘላለም የተሰወረው የምሥጢር ሥርዓት ምን እንደሆነ ለሁሉ እገልጥ ዘንድ ይህ ጸጋ ከቅዱሳን ሁሉ ይልቅ ለማንስ ለኔ ተሰጠ፤

verses.en: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
verses.fr: afin que les dominations et les autorités dans les lieux célestes connaissent aujourd''hui par l''Eglise la sagesse infiniment variée de Dieu,
verses.am: ብዙ ልዩ ልዩ የእግዚአብሔር ጥበብ አሁን በቤተ ክርስቲያን በኩል በሰማያዊ ስፍራ ውስጥ ላሉት አለቆችና ሥልጣናት ትታወቅ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
verses.fr: selon le dessein éternel qu''il a mis à exécution par Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur,
verses.am: ይህም በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ በጌታችን የፈጸመው የዘላለም አሳብ ነበረ፥

verses.en: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
verses.fr: en qui nous avons, par la foi en lui, la liberté de nous approcher de Dieu avec confiance.
verses.am: በእርሱም ዘንድ ባለ እምነታችን በኩል በመታመን ድፍረትና መግባት በእርሱ አለን።

verses.en: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
verses.fr: Aussi je vous demande de ne pas perdre courage à cause de mes tribulations pour vous: elles sont votre gloire.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ስለ እናንተ ስላለ መከራዬ እንዳትታክቱ እለምናችኋለሁ፥ ክብራችሁ ነውና።

verses.en: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.fr: A cause de cela, je fléchis les genoux devant le Père,
verses.am: እንግዲህ በእኛ እንደሚሠራው ኃይል መጠን ከምንለምነው ወይም ከምናስበው ሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ አብልጦ ሊያደርግ ለሚቻለው፥

verses.en: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
verses.fr: duquel tire son nom toute famille dans les cieux et sur la terre,
verses.am: እንግዲህ በእኛ እንደሚሠራው ኃይል መጠን ከምንለምነው ወይም ከምናስበው ሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ አብልጦ ሊያደርግ ለሚቻለው፥

verses.en: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
verses.fr: afin qu''il vous donne, selon la richesse de sa gloire, d''être puissamment fortifiés par son Esprit dans l''homme intérieur,
verses.am: እንግዲህ በእኛ እንደሚሠራው ኃይል መጠን ከምንለምነው ወይም ከምናስበው ሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ አብልጦ ሊያደርግ ለሚቻለው፥

verses.en: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
verses.fr: en sorte que Christ habite dans vos coeurs par la foi; afin qu''étant enracinés et fondés dans l''amour,
verses.am: እንግዲህ በእኛ እንደሚሠራው ኃይል መጠን ከምንለምነው ወይም ከምናስበው ሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ አብልጦ ሊያደርግ ለሚቻለው፥

verses.en: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
verses.fr: vous puissiez comprendre avec tous les saints quelle est la largeur, la longueur, la profondeur et la hauteur,
verses.am: ለእርሱ በቤተ ክርስቲያን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እስከ ትውልዶች ሁሉ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
verses.fr: et connaître l''amour de Christ, qui surpasse toute connaissance, en sorte que vous soyez remplis jusqu''à toute la plénitude de Dieu.
verses.am: ከቅዱሳን ሁሉ ጋር ስፋቱና ርዝመቱ ከፍታውም ጥልቅነቱም ምን ያህል መሆኑን ለማስተዋል፥ ከመታወቅም የሚያልፈውን የክርስቶስን ፍቅር ለማወቅ ትበረቱ ዘንድ፥ እስከ እግዚአብሔርም ፍጹም ሙላት ደርሳችሁ ትሞሉ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
verses.fr: Or, à celui qui peut faire, par la puissance qui agit en nous, infiniment au delà de tout ce que nous demandons ou pensons,
verses.am: እንግዲህ በእኛ እንደሚሠራው ኃይል መጠን ከምንለምነው ወይም ከምናስበው ሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ አብልጦ ሊያደርግ ለሚቻለው፥

verses.en: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
verses.fr: lui soit la gloire dans l''Eglise et en Jésus-Christ, dans toutes les générations, aux siècles des siècles! Amen!
verses.am: ለእርሱ በቤተ ክርስቲያን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እስከ ትውልዶች ሁሉ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
verses.fr: Je vous exhorte donc, moi, le prisonnier dans le Seigneur, à marcher d''une manière digne de la vocation qui vous a été adressée,
verses.am: እንግዲህ በጌታ እስር የሆንሁ እኔ በተጠራችሁበት መጠራታችሁ እንደሚገባ ትመላለሱ ዘንድ እለምናችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
verses.fr: en toute humilité et douceur, avec patience, vous supportant les uns les autres avec charité,
verses.am: በትሕትና ሁሉና በየዋህነት በትዕግሥትም፤ እርስ በርሳችሁ በፍቅር ታገሡ፤

verses.en: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.fr: vous efforçant de conserver l''unité de l''esprit par le lien de la paix.
verses.am: በሰላም ማሰሪያ የመንፈስን አንድነት ለመጠበቅ ትጉ።

verses.en: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
verses.fr: Il y a un seul corps et un seul Esprit, comme aussi vous avez été appelés à une seule espérance par votre vocation;
verses.am: በመጠራታችሁ በአንድ ተስፋ እንደ ተጠራችሁ አንድ አካልና አንድ መንፈስ አለ፤

verses.en: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.fr: il y a un seul Seigneur, une seule foi, un seul baptême,
verses.am: አንድ ጌታ አንድ ሃይማኖት አንዲት ጥምቀት፤

verses.en: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
verses.fr: un seul Dieu et Père de tous, qui est au-dessus de tous, et parmi tous, et en tous.
verses.am: ከሁሉ በላይ የሚሆን በሁሉም የሚሠራ በሁሉም የሚኖር አንድ አምላክ የሁሉም አባት አለ።

verses.en: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
verses.fr: Mais à chacun de nous la grâce a été donnée selon la mesure du don de Christ.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንደ ክርስቶስ ስጦታ መጠን ለእያንዳንዳችን ጸጋ ተሰጠን።

verses.en: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi il est dit: Etant monté en haut, il a emmené des captifs, Et il a fait des dons aux hommes.
verses.am: ስለዚህ። ወደ ላይ በወጣ ጊዜ ምርኮን ማረከ ለሰዎችም ስጦታን ሰጠ ይላል።

verses.en: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.fr: Or, que signifie: Il est monté, sinon qu''il est aussi descendu dans les régions inférieures de la terre?
verses.am: ወደ ምድር ታችኛ ክፍል ደግሞ ወረደ ማለት ካልሆነ፥ ይህ ወጣ ማለትስ ምን ማለት ነው?

verses.en: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
verses.fr: Celui qui est descendu, c''est le même qui est monté au-dessus de tous les cieux, afin de remplir toutes choses.
verses.am: ይህ የወረደው ሁሉን ይሞላ ዘንድ ከሰማያት ሁሉ በላይ የወጣው ደግሞ ያው ነው።

verses.en: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
verses.fr: Et il a donné les uns comme apôtres, les autres comme prophètes, les autres comme évangélistes, les autres comme pasteurs et docteurs,
verses.am: እርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ሐዋርያት፥ ሌሎቹም ነቢያት፥ ሌሎቹም ወንጌልን ሰባኪዎች፥ ሌሎቹም እረኞችና አስተማሪዎች እንዲሆኑ ሰጠ፤

verses.en: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
verses.fr: pour le perfectionnement des saints en vue de l''oeuvre du ministère et de l''édification du corps de Christ,
verses.am: እንደ ስሕተት ሽንገላ ባለ ተንኮል በሰዎችም ማታለል ምክንያት በትምህርት ነፋስ ሁሉ እየተፍገመገምን ወዲያና ወዲህም እየተንሳፈፍን ሕፃናት መሆን ወደ ፊት አይገባንም፥

verses.en: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
verses.fr: jusqu''à ce que nous soyons tous parvenus à l''unité de la foi et de la connaissance du Fils de Dieu, à l''état d''homme fait, à la mesure de la stature parfaite de Christ,
verses.am: እንደ ስሕተት ሽንገላ ባለ ተንኮል በሰዎችም ማታለል ምክንያት በትምህርት ነፋስ ሁሉ እየተፍገመገምን ወዲያና ወዲህም እየተንሳፈፍን ሕፃናት መሆን ወደ ፊት አይገባንም፥

verses.en: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
verses.fr: afin que nous ne soyons plus des enfants, flottants et emportés à tout vent de doctrine, par la tromperie des hommes, par leur ruse dans les moyens de séduction,
verses.am: ነገር ግን እውነትን በፍቅር እየያዝን በነገር ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ራስ ወደሚሆን ወደ ክርስቶስ እንደግ፤

verses.en: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
verses.fr: mais que, professant la vérité dans la charité, nous croissions à tous égards en celui qui est le chef, Christ.
verses.am: ከእርሱም የተነሣ አካል ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ክፍል በልክ እንደሚሠራ፥ በተሰጠለት በጅማት ሁሉ እየተጋጠመና እየተያያዘ፥ ራሱን በፍቅር ለማነጽ አካሉን ያሳድጋል።

verses.en: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
verses.fr: C''est de lui, et grâce à tous les liens de son assistance, que tout le corps, bien coordonné et formant un solide assemblage, tire son accroissement selon la force qui convient à chacune de ses parties, et s''édifie lui-même dans la charité.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አሕዛብ ደግሞ በአእምሮአቸው ከንቱነት እንደሚመላለሱ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንዳትመላለሱ እላለሁ በጌታም ሆኜ እመሰክራለሁ።

verses.en: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
verses.fr: Voici donc ce que je dis et ce que je déclare dans le Seigneur, c''est que vous ne devez plus marcher comme les païens, qui marchent selon la vanité de leurs pensées.
verses.am: እነርሱ ባለማወቃቸው ጠንቅ በልባቸውም ደንዳንነት ጠንቅ ልቡናቸው ጨለመ፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም ሕይወት ራቁ፤

verses.en: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
verses.fr: Ils ont l''intelligence obscurcie, ils sont étrangers à la vie de Dieu, à cause de l''ignorance qui est en eux, à cause de l''endurcissement de leur coeur.
verses.am: ደንዝዘውም በመመኘት ርኵሰትን ሁሉ ለማድረግ ራሳቸውን ወደ ሴሰኝነት አሳልፈው ሰጡ።

verses.en: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
verses.fr: Ayant perdu tout sentiment, ils se sont livrés à la dissolution, pour commettre toute espèce d''impureté jointe à la cupidité.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ክርስቶስን እንደዚህ አልተማራችሁም፤

verses.en: But ye have not so learned Christ;
verses.fr: Mais vous, ce n''est pas ainsi que vous avez appris Christ,
verses.am: በእርግጥ ሰምታችሁታልና፥ እውነትም በኢየሱስ እንዳለ በእርሱ ተምራችኋል፤

verses.en: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
verses.fr: si du moins vous l''avez entendu, et si, conformément à la vérité qui est en Jésus, c''est en lui que vous avez été instruits
verses.am: ፊተኛ ኑሮአችሁን እያሰባችሁ እንደሚያታልል ምኞት የሚጠፋውን አሮጌውን ሰው አስወግዱ፥

verses.en: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
verses.fr: à vous dépouiller, eu égard à votre vie passée, du vieil homme qui se corrompt par les convoitises trompeuses,
verses.am: በአእምሮአችሁም መንፈስ ታደሱ፥

verses.en: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
verses.fr: à être renouvelés dans l''esprit de votre intelligence,
verses.am: ለእውነትም በሚሆኑ ጽድቅና ቅድስና እንደ እግዚአብሔር ምሳሌ የተፈጠረውን አዲሱን ሰው ልበሱ።

verses.en: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
verses.fr: et à revêtir l''homme nouveau, créé selon Dieu dans une justice et une sainteté que produit la vérité.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ውሸትን አስወግዳችሁ፥ እርስ በርሳችን ብልቶች ሆነናልና እያንዳንዳችሁ ከባልንጀሮቻችሁ ጋር እውነትን ተነጋገሩ።

verses.en: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, renoncez au mensonge, et que chacun de vous parle selon la vérité à son prochain; car nous sommes membres les uns des autres.
verses.am: ተቆጡ ኃጢአትንም አታድርጉ፤

verses.en: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
verses.fr: Si vous vous mettez en colère, ne péchez point; que le soleil ne se couche pas sur votre colère,
verses.am: በቁጣችሁ ላይ ፀሐይ አይግባ፥ ለዲያብሎስም ፈንታ አትስጡት።

verses.en: Neither give place to the devil.
verses.fr: et ne donnez pas accès au diable.
verses.am: የሰረቀ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይስረቅ፥ ነገር ግን በዚያ ፈንታ ለጎደለው የሚያካፍለው እንዲኖርለት በገዛ እጆቹ መልካምን እየሠራ ይድከም።

verses.en: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
verses.fr: Que celui qui dérobait ne dérobe plus; mais plutôt qu''il travaille, en faisant de ses mains ce qui est bien, pour avoir de quoi donner à celui qui est dans le besoin.
verses.am: ለሚሰሙት ጸጋን ይሰጥ ዘንድ፥ እንደሚያስፈልግ ለማነጽ የሚጠቅም ማናቸውም በጎ ቃል እንጂ ክፉ ቃል ከአፋችሁ ከቶ አይውጣ።

verses.en: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
verses.fr: Qu''il ne sorte de votre bouche aucune parole mauvaise, mais, s''il y a lieu, quelque bonne parole, qui serve à l''édification et communique une grâce à ceux qui l''entendent.
verses.am: ለቤዛም ቀን የታተማችሁበትን ቅዱሱን የእግዚአብሔርን መንፈስ አታሳዝኑ።

verses.en: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
verses.fr: N''attristez pas le Saint-Esprit de Dieu, par lequel vous avez été scellés pour le jour de la rédemption.
verses.am: መራርነትና ንዴት ቁጣም ጩኸትም መሳደብም ሁሉ ከክፋት ሁሉ ጋር ከእናንተ ዘንድ ይወገድ።

verses.en: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
verses.fr: Que toute amertume, toute animosité, toute colère, toute clameur, toute calomnie, et toute espèce de méchanceté, disparaissent du milieu de vous.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችሁም ቸሮችና ርኅሩኆች ሁኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ በክርስቶስ ይቅር እንዳላችሁ ይቅር ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
verses.fr: Soyez bons les uns envers les autres, compatissants, vous pardonnant réciproquement, comme Dieu vous a pardonné en Christ.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችሁም ቸሮችና ርኅሩኆች ሁኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ በክርስቶስ ይቅር እንዳላችሁ ይቅር ተባባሉ።

verses.en: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
verses.fr: Devenez donc les imitateurs de Dieu, comme des enfants bien-aimés;
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደ ተወደዱ ልጆች እግዚአብሔርን የምትከተሉ ሁኑ፥

verses.en: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
verses.fr: et marchez dans la charité, à l''exemple de Christ, qui nous a aimés, et qui s''est livré lui-même à Dieu pour nous comme une offrande et un sacrifice de bonne odeur.
verses.am: ክርስቶስም ደግሞ እንደ ወደዳችሁ ለእግዚአብሔርም የመዓዛ ሽታ የሚሆንን መባንና መሥዋዕትን አድርጎ ስለ እናንተ ራሱን አሳልፎ እንደ ሰጠ በፍቅር ተመላለሱ።

verses.en: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
verses.fr: Que l''impudicité, qu''aucune espèce d''impureté, et que la cupidité, ne soient pas même nommées parmi vous, ainsi qu''il convient à des saints.
verses.am: ለቅዱሳን እንደሚገባ ግን ዝሙትና ርኵሰት ሁሉ ወይም መመኘት በእናንተ ዘንድ ከቶ አይሰማ፤

verses.en: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
verses.fr: Qu''on n''entende ni paroles déshonnêtes, ni propos insensés, ni plaisanteries, choses qui sont contraires à la bienséance; qu''on entende plutôt des actions de grâces.
verses.am: የሚያሳፍር ነገርም የስንፍና ንግግርም ወይም ዋዛ የማይገቡ ናቸውና አይሁኑ፥ ይልቁን ምስጋና እንጂ።

verses.en: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
verses.fr: Car, sachez-le bien, aucun impudique, ou impur, ou cupide, c''est-à-dire, idolâtre, n''a d''héritage dans le royaume de Christ et de Dieu.
verses.am: ይህን እወቁ፤ አመንዝራም ቢሆን ወይም ርኵስ ወይም የሚመኝ እርሱም ጣዖትን የሚያመልክ በክርስቶስና በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ርስት የለውም።

verses.en: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
verses.fr: Que personne ne vous séduise par de vains discours; car c''est à cause de ces choses que la colère de Dieu vient sur les fils de la rébellion.
verses.am: ከዚህ የተነሣ በማይታዘዙት ልጆች ላይ የእግዚአብሔር ቁጣ ይመጣልና ማንም በከንቱ ንግግር አያታልላችሁ።

verses.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
verses.fr: N''ayez donc aucune part avec eux.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከእነርሱ ጋር ተካፋዮች አትሁኑ፤

verses.en: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
verses.fr: Autrefois vous étiez ténèbres, et maintenant vous êtes lumière dans le Seigneur. Marchez comme des enfants de lumière!
verses.am: ቀድሞ ጨለማ ነበራችሁና፥ አሁን ግን በጌታ ብርሃን ናችሁ፤

verses.en: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
verses.fr: Car le fruit de la lumière consiste en toute sorte de bonté, de justice et de vérité.
verses.am: ፍሬም ከሌለው ከጨለማ ሥራ ጋር አትተባበሩ፥ ይልቁን ግለጡት እንጂ፥

verses.en: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Examinez ce qui est agréable au Seigneur;
verses.am: ፍሬም ከሌለው ከጨለማ ሥራ ጋር አትተባበሩ፥ ይልቁን ግለጡት እንጂ፥

verses.en: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
verses.fr: et ne prenez point part aux oeuvres infructueuses des ténèbres, mais plutôt condamnez-les.
verses.am: እነርሱ በስውር ስለሚያደርጉት መናገር እንኳ ነውር ነውና፤

verses.en: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
verses.fr: Car il est honteux de dire ce qu''ils font en secret;
verses.am: ሁሉ ግን በብርሃን ሲገለጥ ይታያል፤ የሚታየው ሁሉ ብርሃን ነውና።

verses.en: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
verses.fr: mais tout ce qui est condamné est manifesté par la lumière, car tout ce qui est manifesté est lumière.
verses.am: ስለዚህ። አንተ የምትተኛ ንቃ ከሙታንም ተነሣ ክርስቶስም ያበራልሃል ይላል።

verses.en: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
verses.fr: C''est pour cela qu''il est dit: Réveille-toi, toi qui dors, Relève-toi d''entre les morts, Et Christ t''éclairera.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደ ጥበበኞች እንጂ ጥበብ እንደሌላቸው ሳይሆን እንዴት እንድትመላለሱ በጥንቃቄ ተጠበቁ፤

verses.en: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
verses.fr: Prenez donc garde de vous conduire avec circonspection, non comme des insensés, mais comme des sages;
verses.am: ቀኖቹ ክፉዎች ናቸውና ዘመኑን ዋጁ።

verses.en: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.fr: rachetez le temps, car les jours sont mauvais.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የጌታ ፈቃድ ምን እንደ ሆነ አስተውሉ እንጂ ሞኞች አትሁኑ።

verses.en: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ne soyez pas inconsidérés, mais comprenez quelle est la volonté du Seigneur.
verses.am: መንፈስ ይሙላባችሁ እንጂ በወይን ጠጅ አትስከሩ ይህ ማባከን ነውና፤

verses.en: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
verses.fr: Ne vous enivrez pas de vin: c''est de la débauche. Soyez, au contraire, remplis de l''Esprit;
verses.am: በመዝሙርና በዝማሬ በመንፈሳዊም ቅኔ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተነጋገሩ፤ ለጌታ በልባችሁ ተቀኙና ዘምሩ፤

verses.en: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
verses.fr: entretenez-vous par des psaumes, par des hymnes, et par des cantiques spirituels, chantant et célébrant de tout votre coeur les louanges du Seigneur;
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ ስለ ሁሉ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም አምላካችንንና አባታችንን ስለ ሁሉ አመስግኑ።

verses.en: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.fr: rendez continuellement grâces pour toutes choses à Dieu le Père, au nom de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ,
verses.am: ለእያንዳንዳችሁ በክርስቶስ ፍርሃት የተገዛችሁ ሁኑ።

verses.en: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
verses.fr: vous soumettant les uns aux autres dans la crainte de Christ.
verses.am: ሚስቶች ሆይ፥ ለጌታ እንደምትገዙ ለባሎቻችሁ ተገዙ፤

verses.en: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Femmes, soyez soumises à vos maris, comme au Seigneur;
verses.am: ክርስቶስ ደግሞ የቤተ ክርስቲያን ራስ እንደ ሆነ እርሱም አካሉን የሚያድን እንደ ሆነ ባል የሚስት ራስ ነውና።

verses.en: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
verses.fr: car le mari est le chef de la femme, comme Christ est le chef de l''Eglise, qui est son corps, et dont il est le Sauveur.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ለክርስቶስ እንደምትገዛ እንዲሁ ሚስቶች ደግሞ በሁሉ ለባሎቻቸው ይገዙ።

verses.en: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
verses.fr: Or, de même que l''Eglise est soumise à Christ, les femmes aussi doivent l''être à leurs maris en toutes choses.
verses.am: እድፈት ወይም የፊት መጨማደድ ወይም እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ሳይሆንባት ቅድስትና ያለ ነውር ትሆን ዘንድ ክብርት የሆነችን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ለራሱ እንዲያቀርብ ፈለገ።

verses.en: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
verses.fr: Maris, aimez vos femmes, comme Christ a aimé l''Eglise, et s''est livré lui-même pour elle,
verses.am: እድፈት ወይም የፊት መጨማደድ ወይም እንዲህ ያለ ነገር ሳይሆንባት ቅድስትና ያለ ነውር ትሆን ዘንድ ክብርት የሆነችን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ለራሱ እንዲያቀርብ ፈለገ።

verses.en: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
verses.fr: afin de la sanctifier par la parole, après l''avoir purifiée par le baptême d''eau,
verses.am: እንዲሁም ባሎች ደግሞ እንደ ገዛ ሥጋቸው አድርገው የገዛ ሚስቶቻቸውን ሊወዱአቸው ይገባቸዋል። የገዛ ሚስቱን የሚወድ ራሱን ይወዳል፤

verses.en: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
verses.fr: afin de faire paraître devant lui cette Eglise glorieuse, sans tache, ni ride, ni rien de semblable, mais sainte et irrépréhensible.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል ከሚስቱም ጋር ይተባበራል ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que les maris doivent aimer leurs femmes comme leurs propres corps. Celui qui aime sa femme s''aime lui-même.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል ከሚስቱም ጋር ይተባበራል ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
verses.fr: Car jamais personne n''a haï sa propre chair; mais il la nourrit et en prend soin, comme Christ le fait pour l''Eglise,
verses.am: ይህ ምሥጢር ታላቅ ነው፥ እኔ ግን ይህን ስለ ክርስቶስና ስለ ቤተ ክርስቲያን እላለሁ።

verses.en: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
verses.fr: parce que nous sommes membres de son corps.
verses.am: ሆኖም ከእናንተ ደግሞ እያንዳንዱ የገዛ ሚስቱን እንዲህ እንደ ራሱ አድርጎ ይውደዳት፥ ሚስቱም ባልዋን ትፍራ።

verses.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi l''homme quittera son père et sa mère, et s''attachera à sa femme, et les deux deviendront une seule chair.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል ከሚስቱም ጋር ይተባበራል ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
verses.fr: Ce mystère est grand; je dis cela par rapport à Christ et à l''Eglise.
verses.am: ይህ ምሥጢር ታላቅ ነው፥ እኔ ግን ይህን ስለ ክርስቶስና ስለ ቤተ ክርስቲያን እላለሁ።

verses.en: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
verses.fr: Du reste, que chacun de vous aime sa femme comme lui-même, et que la femme respecte son mari.
verses.am: ሆኖም ከእናንተ ደግሞ እያንዳንዱ የገዛ ሚስቱን እንዲህ እንደ ራሱ አድርጎ ይውደዳት፥ ሚስቱም ባልዋን ትፍራ።

verses.en: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verses.fr: Enfants, obéissez à vos parents, selon le Seigneur, car cela est juste.
verses.am: ልጆች ሆይ፥ ለወላጆቻችሁ በጌታ ታዘዙ፥ ይህ የሚገባ ነውና።

verses.en: Honour thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;
verses.fr: Honore ton père et ta mère c''est le premier commandement avec une promesse,

verses.en: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
verses.fr: afin que tu sois heureux et que tu vives longtemps sur la terre.
verses.am: መልካም እንዲሆንልህ ዕድሜህም በምድር ላይ እንዲረዝም አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ እርስዋም የተስፋ ቃል ያላት ፊተኛይቱ ትእዛዝ ናት።

verses.en: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
verses.fr: Et vous, pères, n''irritez pas vos enfants, mais élevez-les en les corrigeant et en les instruisant selon le Seigneur.
verses.am: እናንተም አባቶች ሆይ፥ ልጆቻችሁን በጌታ ምክርና በተግሣጽ አሳድጉአቸው እንጂ አታስቆጡአቸው።

verses.en: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
verses.fr: Serviteurs, obéissez à vos maîtres selon la chair, avec crainte et tremblement, dans la simplicité de votre coeur, comme à Christ,
verses.am: ባሪያዎች ሆይ፥ ለክርስቶስ እንደምትታዘዙ በፍርሃትና በመንቀጥቀጥ በልባችሁ ቅንነት በሥጋ ጌቶቻችሁ ለሆኑ ታዘዙ፤

verses.en: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
verses.fr: non pas seulement sous leurs yeux, comme pour plaire aux hommes, mais comme des serviteurs de Christ, qui font de bon coeur la volonté de Dieu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ እንደሚያደርጉ እንደ ክርስቶስ ባሪያዎች እንጂ ለሰው ደስ እንደምታሰኙ ለታይታ የምትገዙ አትሁኑ።

verses.en: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
verses.fr: Servez-les avec empressement, comme servant le Seigneur et non des hommes,
verses.am: ለሰው ሳይሆን ለጌታ እንደምትገዙ በትጋትና በበጎ ፈቃድ ተገዙ፤

verses.en: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
verses.fr: sachant que chacun, soit esclave, soit libre, recevra du Seigneur selon ce qu''il aura fait de bien.
verses.am: ባሪያ ቢሆን ወይም ጨዋ ሰው፥ እያንዳንዱ የሚያደርገውን መልካም ነገር ሁሉ ከጌታ በብድራት እንዲቀበለው ታውቃላችሁና።

verses.en: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
verses.fr: Et vous, maîtres, agissez de même à leur égard, et abstenez-vous de menaces, sachant que leur maître et le vôtre est dans les cieux, et que devant lui il n''y a point d''acception de personnes.
verses.am: እናንተም ጌቶች ሆይ፥ ዛቻውን ትታችሁ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው፥ በእነርሱና በእናንተ ላይ የሚገዛው ጌታ በሰማይ እንዳለ ለሰው ፊትም እንዳያደላ ታውቃላችሁና።

verses.en: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verses.fr: Au reste, fortifiez-vous dans le Seigneur, et par sa force toute-puissante.
verses.am: በቀረውስ በጌታና በኃይሉ ችሎት የበረታችሁ ሁኑ።

verses.en: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.fr: Revêtez-vous de toutes les armes de Dieu, afin de pouvoir tenir ferme contre les ruses du diable.
verses.am: የዲያብሎስን ሽንገላ ትቃወሙ ዘንድ እንዲቻላችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ዕቃ ጦር ሁሉ ልበሱ።

verses.en: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
verses.fr: Car nous n''avons pas à lutter contre la chair et le sang, mais contre les dominations, contre les autorités, contre les princes de ce monde de ténèbres, contre les esprits méchants dans les lieux célestes.
verses.am: መጋደላችን ከደምና ከሥጋ ጋር አይደለምና፥ ከአለቆችና ከሥልጣናት ጋር ከዚህም ከጨለማ ዓለም ገዦች ጋር በሰማያዊም ስፍራ ካለ ከክፋት መንፈሳውያን ሠራዊት ጋር ነው እንጂ።

verses.en: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, prenez toutes les armes de Dieu, afin de pouvoir résister dans le mauvais jour, et tenir ferme après avoir tout surmonté.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በክፉው ቀን ለመቃወም፥ ሁሉንም ፈጽማችሁ ለመቆም እንድትችሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ዕቃ ጦር ሁሉ አንሡ።

verses.en: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
verses.fr: Tenez donc ferme: ayez à vos reins la vérité pour ceinture; revêtez la cuirasse de la justice;
verses.am: በሁሉም ላይ ጨምራችሁ የሚንበለበሉትን የክፉውን ፍላጻዎች ሁሉ ልታጠፉ የምትችሉበትን የእምነትን ጋሻ አንሡ፤

verses.en: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verses.fr: mettez pour chaussure à vos pieds le zèle que donne l''Evangile de paix;
verses.am: በሁሉም ላይ ጨምራችሁ የሚንበለበሉትን የክፉውን ፍላጻዎች ሁሉ ልታጠፉ የምትችሉበትን የእምነትን ጋሻ አንሡ፤

verses.en: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
verses.fr: prenez par-dessus tout cela le bouclier de la foi, avec lequel vous pourrez éteindre tous les traits enflammés du malin;
verses.am: የመዳንንም ራስ ቁር የመንፈስንም ሰይፍ ያዙ እርሱም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ነው።

verses.en: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
verses.fr: prenez aussi le casque du salut, et l''épée de l''Esprit, qui est la parole de Dieu.
verses.am: በጸሎትና በልመናም ሁሉ ዘወትር በመንፈስ ጸልዩ፤ በዚህም አሳብ ስለ ቅዱሳን ሁሉ እየለመናችሁ በመጽናት ሁሉ ትጉ፤

verses.en: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
verses.fr: Faites en tout temps par l''Esprit toutes sortes de prières et de supplications. Veillez à cela avec une entière persévérance, et priez pour tous les saints.
verses.am: ደግሞ የወንጌልን ምሥጢር በግልጥ እንዳስታውቅ አፌን በመክፈት ቃል ይሰጠኝ ዘንድ ስለ እኔ ለምኑ፤

verses.en: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
verses.fr: Priez pour moi, afin qu''il me soit donné, quand j''ouvre la bouche, de faire connaître hardiment et librement le mystère de l''Evangile,
verses.am: ስለ ወንጌልም በሰንሰለት መልእክተኛ የሆንሁ፥ መናገር እንደሚገባኝ ስለ እርሱ በግልጥ እናገር ዘንድ ለምኑ።

verses.en: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.fr: pour lequel je suis ambassadeur dans les chaînes, et que j''en parle avec assurance comme je dois en parler.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እናንተ ደግሞ እንዴት እንዳለሁ ኑሮዬን እንድታውቁ የተወደደ ወንድምና በጌታ የታመነ አገልጋይ ቲኪቆስ ሁሉን ያስታውቃችኋል፤

verses.en: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
verses.fr: Afin que vous aussi, vous sachiez ce qui me concerne, ce que je fais, Tychique, le bien-aimé frère et fidèle ministre dans le Seigneur, vous informera de tout.
verses.am: ወሬአችንን እንድታውቁና ልባችሁን እንዲያጽናና ወደ እናንተ የምልከው ስለዚህ ምክንያት ነው።

verses.en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
verses.fr: Je l''envoie exprès vers vous, pour que vous connaissiez notre situation, et pour qu''il console vos coeurs.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር አብ ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሰላምና ፍቅር ከእምነት ጋር ለወንድሞች ይሁን።

verses.en: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: Que la paix et la charité avec la foi soient données aux frères de la part de Dieu le Père et du Seigneur Jésus-Christ!
verses.am: ጌታችንን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ባለመጥፋት ከሚወዱ ሁሉ ጋር ጸጋ ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
verses.fr: Que la grâce soit avec tous ceux qui aiment notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ d''un amour inaltérable!
verses.am: ጌታችንን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ባለመጥፋት ከሚወዱ ሁሉ ጋር ጸጋ ይሁን፤ አሜን።
